findings.current: First: They would meet at a midpoint in half an hour, with their weapons put away.
findings.defect: Putting weapons away allows the attendees to remain armed; the condition requires them to disarm.
findings.rationale: 무장을 해제한 채 specifies disarmament, not merely sheathing or stowing weapons.
findings.replacement: First: They would meet at a midpoint in half an hour, unarmed.
findings.source: 무장을 해제한 채 중간 지점에서 만날 것.

findings.current: “Even if there were only ten prisoners instead of a thousand—or a hundred—you’d still go. That’s the kind of person you are, as far as this old man knows.”
findings.defect: The draft changes ten thousand prisoners to a hundred.
findings.rationale: 만 명 is ten thousand; 천 명 is one thousand.
findings.replacement: “Even if there were only ten prisoners instead of ten thousand or a thousand, you’d still go. That’s the kind of person you are, as far as this old man knows.”
findings.source: 만약 사로잡힌 포로가 만 명, 천 명이 아니라 열 명뿐이었어도 갔겠지.

findings.current:
Why?

Why was I doing this?

I didn’t know the exact reason.
findings.defect: The draft makes Taekyung question his own decision to go, rather than leave the object of his question unstated.
findings.rationale: The following conversation concerns why Sama Pyo volunteered; the source does not ask why Taekyung himself is going.
findings.replacement:
Why?

Why had it turned out this way?

I didn’t know the exact reason.

findings.current: He had every reason to volunteer, and every right to do so. Maybe that was why everyone accepted the young man’s sudden move without much fuss.
findings.defect: The first justification belongs to those who would try to stop Sama Pyo; the draft assigns both justifications to his volunteering.
findings.rationale: 만류하는 명분 contrasts the grounds for dissuading him with 나설 만한 자격, his standing to volunteer.
findings.replacement: There were plenty of grounds for trying to stop him, but he was also qualified to step forward. Perhaps that was why everyone accepted the young man’s sudden move without much fuss.
findings.source: 만류하는 명분도, 나설 만한 자격도 충분했고 그래서인지 다들 젊은 놈의 돌발행동을 고분고분하게 받아들였다.

findings.current: *“No, that’s because of the sunset. The sky is blue. My stock’s just going through a rough patch.”*
findings.defect: “Rough patch” drops the father’s claim that his stock is only temporarily blue, breaking the setup for the child’s question about its turning red.
findings.rationale: 잠깐 그런 것뿐 ties the stock’s current color to the sky’s color; the next line asks whether the stock will soon turn red.
findings.replacement: *“No, that’s because of the sunset. The sky is blue. My stock’s only blue for a little while, too.”*

summary: The draft changes the number of prisoners in Jeok Cheongang’s hypothetical, weakens the disarmament condition, and misassigns the grounds for objecting to Sama Pyo’s departure.
